_howto: Weekly update: add a new object at the TOP of "weeks" (newest first). Each pick needs type ("wall" or "bingo") and nick. Optional: text, score (bingo, 0-25), seed (bingo card number), source ("wall" or "telegram"), image (only files in assets/halloffame/, .webp/.png/.jpg). Keep "weeks" empty to show the 'First picks: this week' card. Copy the shape from _example. Recognition only: no prizes are listed here.
